name: Shradha AI Technologies Ltd
summary: Shradha AI Technologies Limited provides solutions to the complex information management requirements. It offers IT consulting, mobile app development, website development, and data analytics services. The company is also involved in the wholesale trading of computers, computer hardware, and accessories. The company was formerly known as Shradha Industries Limited and changed its name to Shradha AI Technologies Limited in September 2023. Shradha AI Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Nagpur, India.
